hero.title: Problems Surface Before Anyone Notices.
hero.description: Define your business cadences. Team members report by voice. AI scores health automatically and flags anomalies with corrective actions.

body: The Operations module doesn't wait for someone to notice problems — it detects them automatically. Admin configures rules per operation: 'if completion rate drops below 90%, flag yellow; below 70%, flag red.' When team members submit reports via voice, dictation, chat, or form, the system evaluates every rule, calculates compliance scores, produces health status, and immediately surfaces results on the dashboard. Across multiple report runs, it tracks trends and alerts on anomalies before they become crises.

dashboard.title: Live Health Dashboard

aiAlert.label: AI Action:
aiAlert.message: Equipment check completion dropped from 95% to 41% this month. Recommend: schedule mandatory training + reassign to senior technician.

dashboard.footnote: Health scores update automatically when reports are submitted. No manual tracking.

reporting.title: 4 ways to report
reporting.description: Voice interview, dictation, chat, or traditional form. Field workers fill reports by talking on the drive back. No clipboards.

rules.title: Rules catch problems
rules.description: Configure thresholds: "if daily_revenue < $5K, flag RED." Compliance scoring tracks timeliness. Late = proportionally lower score.

ai.title: AI corrective actions
ai.description: When health drops, AI generates 3-5 specific actions with urgency levels. Not vague advice — concrete next steps routed to the right people.

without.label: Without HABOS
without.description: Friday: "How's the safety audit going?" "Uh, let me check." Monday: "Turns out 3 sites skipped it." Wednesday: incident report.

with.label: With HABOS
with.description: Tuesday: Auto-alert — "Safety audit completion at 67%, 3 sites overdue. Suggested: reassign to backup inspectors." Action taken same day.

cta.heading: Other tools track what happened. HABOS catches what's about to go wrong.
